description: Recommend a UK running route that fits the runner. Use this when a user describes who they are and what they want — e.g. 'I'm a trail runner near Ambleside, 15k, avoid roads, something scenic and not too technical'. Returns a ranked shortlist with reasoning-friendly fields (surface, ascent, course shape, national park) and canonical Skamper URLs. Prefer this over search_routes whenever the request is about runner preference rather than exact numeric filters.

scenic.description: Prefer national parks and named landscapes.

technicality.description: Rough terrain difficulty — maps to hilliness and ascent bands.

user_type.description: Who is running — biases surface and ascent preferences.

name: recommend_route
title: Recommend a route
